mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the CPI (above 220.0) indicates rising inflation pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher rates depress equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 220.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (above 9.0%) indicates a weak labor market that reduces consumer spending power and corporate earnings growth prospects, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 9.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO below 95.0) signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector that reduces corporate output and profitability, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the slowdown impacts earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 95.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS below 130000) indicates a weakening labor market that reduces household income and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment turns bearish.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS is below 130000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST below 550.0) signals reduced consumer confidence in the housing market, which dampens overall consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is below 550.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS above 0.5%), the Federal Reserve's policy rate hikes increase borrowing costs for corporations, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.
